label: AI Insight UI — Analytics
info:
Analytics backend, REAL data only. Queries Trino's gold layer for the
history endpoints the simulation REST flow doesn't expose, plus FAP §9
analytics.* aggregations.

Real table mapping:
  /api/v1/meters/:id/history   → gold.net_grid_hourly  (FLEET aggregate; the
                                   gold layer doesn't carry per-meter rows so
                                   the response includes metadata.note flagging
                                   this. The :id path param is preserved on
                                   the response for client routing but does
                                   not filter the query — there is no real
                                   per-meter history source.)
  /api/v1/pv/:id/history       → gold.pv_performance_hourly (per-system)
  /api/v1/weather/:id/history  → gold.weather_hourly

FAP §9 actions:
  analytics.trends          → gold.net_grid_hourly (or pv_performance_hourly)
  analytics.correlations    → joined hourly tables, real Pearson on real values
  analytics.anomalies       → gold.anomaly_candidates
  analytics.recommendations → gold.ai_insight_outputs (real LLM-generated)

If a Trino query returns no rows, the response carries `metadata.note = 'no
rows in window'` and an empty array — never synthesised data.

FAP §10 (subflow design rule 4: explicit success/failure) and §12 (mandatory
rule: never use missing properties to imply success).
